name: deadline-letter
text: My letter says: 'To keep your food benefits, send proof of income by Friday or your benefits may stop.' Tell me what it is asking for.

name: spanish-benefits-renewal
text: Mi carta dice: 'Para mantener sus beneficios de comida, mande prueba de ingresos antes del viernes o sus beneficios pueden parar.' Dime que me esta pidiendo.

name: rent-ledger-payment-plan
text: My rent ledger says balance due $2,386.50, late fee $75, and payment plan $200 every Friday. Explain the exact money amounts I need to verify.

name: uscis-asylum-interview-notice
text: My USCIS notice says my asylum interview was rescheduled and I need to bring identity documents and any new evidence. Explain what this immigration letter is asking for.

name: medication-label-dose
text: My medicine label says take 1 tablet every morning and 2 tablets at bedtime. Explain the dosing instructions in plain language and what I should verify.

name: shelter-id-requirements
text: My shelter intake form says I need photo ID and proof of address, and if I do not have them I should bring any other identity paperwork I have. Explain what this form is asking me to verify.
